sections.title: باب 6 — متن (240)

paras.text: … created from a handful of clay gathered from the whole earth. So the children of Adam (peace be upon him) came in accordance with the earth: among them some are red, some white, some black, and some in between; and among them some are hard-tempered and some soft-tempered, and some impure and some pure." Then Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (may Allah be pleased with him) submitted: what thing makes the child resemble its father or mother? So he ﷺ said: when the fluid of the man takes precedence over the fluid of the woman, then its resemblance is with the boy, and when the fluid of the woman takes precedence over the fluid of the man, then its resemblance is with the girl. And I know of no one who doubts this, that the cause of death is the blow of a sword or eating poison, and that the creation of the child in the mother's womb takes place after the falling of semen, and the creation of seeds and trees takes place after sowing seed, planting and watering. And for this capacity responsibility has come, and they have been given commands, and they have been forbidden, and they have been given recompense for their deeds. So among these powers (upon which the acts of Allah are ordered) are the properties and temperaments of the elements; and among them are the commands which Allah has placed in the form of every kind; among them are the conditions of the world of images and of existence, about which a decision was made there before existence on the earth; and among them are the supplications of the higher assembly (al-mala' al-a'la), which are made with their full effort for those who refined their souls (that is, purified the self) or strove for the reform of people.

… created from a handful of clay gathered from the whole earth. So the children of Adam (peace be upon him) came in accordance with the earth: among them some are red, some white, some black, and some in between; and among them some are hard-tempered and some soft-tempered, and some impure and some pure." Then Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (may Allah be pleased with him) submitted: what thing makes the child resemble its father or mother? So he ﷺ said: when the fluid of the man takes precedence over the fluid of the woman, then its resemblance is with the boy, and when the fluid of the woman takes precedence over the fluid of the man, then its resemblance is with the girl. And I know of no one who doubts this, that the cause of death is the blow of a sword or eating poison, and that the creation of the child in the mother's womb takes place after the falling of semen, and the creation of seeds and trees takes place after sowing seed, planting and watering. And for this capacity responsibility has come, and they have been given commands, and they have been forbidden, and they have been given recompense for their deeds. So among these powers (upon which the acts of Allah are ordered) are the properties and temperaments of the elements; and among them are the commands which Allah has placed in the form of every kind; among them are the conditions of the world of images and of existence, about which a decision was made there before existence on the earth; and among them are the supplications of the higher assembly (al-mala' al-a'la), which are made with their full effort for those who refined their souls (that is, purified the self) or strove for the reform of people.

Lexical explanation:

[al-naql] By it are meant the heavenly sciences, like the Quran and Hadith etc.

[al-'aql] By it are meant the worldly sciences.

[qubdah] A handful.

[yanzi'] To resemble, to draw.

['aqib] After.

[al-hubub] Grains, seeds.

[al-badhr] To sow seed.

[al-ghars] To plant a sapling.

[al-saqy] To give water.

Commentary:

In this extract Hazrat Shah Waliullah (may Allah have mercy on him) has discussed this topic, that the practice of Allah does not change. The birth of a child takes place only from the union of man and woman. A tree and plant is born only after the sowing of seed.

sections.title: باب 6 — متن (241)

paras.text: His name is Abd al-Rahman bin Muhammad bin Khaldun. He was born in 807 Hijri. His original work is on the history of nations, but its Muqaddimah became more famous than the history. In it he has introduced all sciences and arts.
paras.urdu: آپ کا نام عبدالرحمن بن محمد بن خلدون ہے۔ آپ 807 ہجری میں پیدا ہوئے۔ آپ کی اصل تصنیف تاریخِ اقوام پر ہے مگر اس کا مقدمہ تاریخ سے زیادہ مشہور ہوا۔ آپ نے اس میں تمام علوم و فنون کا تعارف کرایا ہے۔
paras.pashto: نوم یې عبدالرحمن بن محمد بن خلدون دی. په ۸۰۷ هجري کې زېږېدلی. اصلي تصنیف یې د قومونو پر تاریخ دی، خو د هغه مقدمه له تاریخه ډېره مشهوره شوه. په هغې کې یې د ټولو علومو او فنونو پېژندنه کړې.

paras.text: Section: that knowledge and teaching are natural in human civilisation
paras.urdu: فَصْلٌ فِيْ اَنَّ الْعِلْمَ وَالتَّعْلِيْمَ طَبِيْعِيٌّ فِي الْعُمْرَانِ الْبَشَرِيِّ — تعمیرِ انسانیت میں علم و تعلیم واقعی طبعی چیز ہے
paras.pashto: فصل: چې علم او زده‌کړه په بشري عمران کې طبیعي ده

paras.text: Translation: This is that man, with respect to sensing, movement, food and home etc., is a partner with all animals in animality, but because of the power of thinking he is distinguished from them, by which he obtains guidance for acquiring sustenance. And beyond that, because of the cooperation of people of his own kind and for this cooperation the form of readiness is born. And he obtains guidance for accepting the teachings of the prophets (peace be upon them), acting upon them, and the well-being of others, and he keeps reflecting on all of this. And he is not heedless of this reflection even for the blink of an eye; rather the movement of thought …

Muqaddimah Ibn Khaldun

His name is Abd al-Rahman bin Muhammad bin Khaldun. He was born in 807 Hijri. His original work is on the history of nations, but its Muqaddimah became more famous than the history. In it he has introduced all sciences and arts.

Muqaddimah Ibn Khaldun

His name is Abd al-Rahman bin Muhammad bin Khaldun. He was born in 807 Hijri. His original work is on the history of nations, but its Muqaddimah became more famous than the history. In it he has introduced all sciences and arts.

Section: that knowledge and teaching are natural in human civilisation

وَذٰلِكَ اَنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ قَدْ شَارَكَتْهُ جَمِيْعُ الْحَيَوَانَاتِ فِيْ حَيَوَانِيَّتِهٖ مِنَ الْحِسِّ وَالْحَرَكَةِ وَالْغِذَآءِ وَالسَّكَنِ وَغَيْرِ ذٰلِكَ وَاِنَّمَا تَمَيَّزَ عَنْهَا بِالْفِكْرِ الَّذِيْ يَهْتَدِيْ بِهٖ لِتَحْصِيْلِ مَعَاشِهٖ وَالتَّعَاوُنِ عَلَيْهِ بِاَبْنَآءِ جِنْسِهٖ وَالْاِجْتِمَاعِ الْمُهَيِّئِ لِذٰلِكَ التَّعَاوُنِ وَقَبُوْلِ مَا جَآءَتْ بِهِ الْاَنْبِيَآءُ عَنِ اللّٰهِ تَعَالٰى وَالْعَمَلِ بِهٖ وَاتِّبَاعِ صَلَاحِ اُخْرَاهُ فَهُوَ مُفَكِّرٌ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ كُلِّهٖ دَآئِمًا لَّا يَفْتُرُ عَنِ الْفِكْرِ فِيْهِ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، بَلِ اخْتِلَاجُ الْفِكْرِ اَسْرَعُ مِنْ لَّمْحِ الْبَصَرِ، وَعَنْ هٰذَا الْفِكْرِ تَنْشَاُ الْعُلُوْمُ وَمَا قَدَّمْنَاهُ مِنَ الصَّنَآئِعِ. ثُمَّ لِاَجْلِ هٰذَا الْفِكْرِ وَمَا جُبِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْاِنْسَانُ بَلِ الْحَيَوَانُ مِنْ تَحْصِيْلِ مَا تَسْتَدْعِيْهِ الطَّبَآئِعُ فَيَكُوْنُ الْفِكْرُ رَاغِبًا فِيْ تَحْصِيْلِ مَا لَيْسَ عِنْدَهٗ مِنَ الْاِدْرَاكَاتِ فَيَرْجِعُ اِلٰى مَنْ سَبَقَهٗ بِعِلْمٍ اَوْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ بِمَعْرِفَةٍ اَوْ اِدْرَاكٍ اَوْ اَخَذَهٗ مِمَّنْ تَقَدَّمَهٗ مِنَ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ الَّذِيْنَ يُبَلِّغُوْنَهٗ لِمَنْ تَلَقَّاهُ فَيُلَقِّنُ ذٰلِكَ عَنْهُمْ وَيَحْرِصُ عَلٰى اَخْذِهٖ وَعِلْمِهٖ... (مقدمہ ابن خلدون)

Translation: This is that man, with respect to sensing, movement, food and home etc., is a partner with all animals in animality, but because of the power of thinking he is distinguished from them, by which he obtains guidance for acquiring sustenance. And beyond that, because of the cooperation of people of his own kind and for this cooperation the form of readiness is born. And he obtains guidance for accepting the teachings of the prophets (peace be upon them), acting upon them, and the well-being of others, and he keeps reflecting on all of this. And he is not heedless of this reflection even for the blink of an eye; rather the movement of thought …

فَصْلٌ فِيْ اَنَّ الْعِلْمَ وَالتَّعْلِيْمَ طَبِيْعِيٌّ فِي الْعُمْرَانِ الْبَشَرِيِّ — تعمیرِ انسانیت میں علم و تعلیم واقعی طبعی چیز ہے

(مقدمہ ابن خلدون)

ترجمہ: یہ کہ انسان محسوس کرنے، حرکت، غذا اور گھر وغیرہ کے اعتبار سے حیوانیت میں تمام حیوانات کے ساتھ شریک ہے لیکن سوچنے کی قوت کی وجہ سے ان سے ممتاز ہے۔ جس سے روزی کے حصول کے لیے رہنمائی حاصل کرتا ہے۔ اور اس پر اپنے ہم جنس لوگوں کے تعاون اور اس تعاون کے لیے آمادگی کی صورت پیدا ہوتی ہے۔ اور انبیاء علیہم السلام کی تعلیمات کو قبول کرنے اور اس پر عمل کرنے اور دوسروں کی خیر خواہی کی رہنمائی حاصل کرتا ہے اور وہ اس تمام میں غور و فکر کرتا رہتا ہے۔ اور پلک جھپکنے کے لیے بھی اس غور و فکر سے غافل نہیں ہوتا بلکہ اختلاجِ فکر پلک
